examples.name: Valley
examples.description: A 2 km mountain valley to fly through, with a day and night cycle: landscape layers for ground, rock, snow, forest floor, roads and trails; meadow grass, spruce forest, oaks about the hamlet and bushes made with the Foliage Creator; a torch-lit hamlet with enterable houses, a windmill, a campfire, a pond with floating crates, mist and god rays, all lit by baked GI volumes and light probes. Play opens a menu: a cinematic tour of the valley (made with the sequencer) or a free camera to fly.

examples.name: Dungeon
examples.description: A souls-like in a three-level torch-lit dungeon: stamina combat, rolls, lock-on, a bonfire that saves the game, Estus, Hollows, a sorcerer and an elite knight, breakable barrels, messages and pickups, and a boss behind a fog gate in its throne arena.

examples.name: Firing Line
examples.description: A first-person shooter: walk, sprint, crouch, aim down sights, hip and aimed fire, reloads and three weapons against bots that search, take cover, retreat when hurt and call for reinforcements. One scene, one Game Manager with a game-type list (one against all, team deathmatch, free for all): put the manager and some fighters in any scene and it plays.

examples.name: Duskwell
examples.description: A small 2D metroidvania on the flat 2D renderer: a warrior with a three-hit combo, bats that wake as you pass, two rooms the camera slides between, one-way platforms, checkpoints that save the game, diamonds, and the dash relic that carries you over the pit. Pixel-perfect at 480 x 270, with parallax backdrops and glowing torches.

examples.name: Island
examples.description: A water demo: an island from the World Creator in open sea, with lakes and rivers that run from the peak into the lake and on to the sea, the Valley's forests, meadows and hamlet, drizzle, wind and a day cycle.

examples.name: Sandbox
examples.description: A locomotion sandbox in the style of Advanced Locomotion System v4: a mannequin that walks and jogs in eight directions facing the camera, sprints freely, sets off, stops and turns round with their own clips, leans into curves, turns in place when you look away, jumps, falls and lands soft or hard, with its feet planted and locked by IK on ramps, stairs and bumps. Two camera rigs (V switches). All of it is the animator, the Character node and one input-only script.
